segments.contextAfter: `originProvider`: The originProvider block object should return the baseline origin for the first character at the adjusted range. If the view is an instance of NSTextView, the originProvider can be `NULL`, in which case the text view will automatically supply values suitable for displaying definitions for the specified range within its text content. The block object takes a single argument: - **adjustedRange**: The adjusted range. The block object returns an `NSPoint` to be used as the baseline origin of the first character, in the view’s view coordinate system.
